name: getJob
description: I look up a single job by name or ID and show everything I know about it. Every field, every config option, the full action definition, the schedule, the last result, the last error, the run count, the failure count.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: I need the exact job name I used when I created it, or the UUID I returned from createJob. I try the name first, then the UUID. Either one works.
